title: 内角低位对向线
description: 木版画用两面宽手点和低脚点呈现浅角中的自然对向支撑。

art_direction.medium: hand-painted oil illustration with restrained impasto
art_direction.scene: Create an original woodcut-style illustration of a fictional adult balancing across a shallow indoor corner using broad opposing handholds and positive low footholds. The stance remains comfortable, with naturally bent knees and no exaggerated split. One hand prepares a short neighboring reach while the other contacts and both feet support the torso just above thick continuous crash mats. Show the whole opaque-clothed adult in a wide three-quarter view that reveals both wall planes and generous empty landing space. Carved navy contours, warm ivory grain, and restrained vermilion hold accents create strong original forms. Keep hand orientation believable. No lettering, logos, jumps, extreme strain, or dangerous height.
